options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The group will pull off at the next exit.

questions.explanation: Group riders use hand signals to communicate. When the lead rider raises their left arm and points one finger, it means the group should line up in single file.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.

questions.explanation: Motorcyclists use hand signals instead of mechanical turn signals. When the left arm is extended straight out, it means the rider plans to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must always come to a complete stop. Only proceed when it is safe.
